title: Build and Deploy Pipeline (Frontend)
purpose: Trace the frontend build pipeline from TypeScript source through type checking, bundling by Vite, and deployment to production (Netlify) and preview (Cloudflare Pages) environments.
audience: Frontend developers, DevOps engineers, CI/CD maintainers
description: Frontend build pipeline: TypeScript source in podm-frontend/src/ -> TypeScript checking (tsc) -> Vite build with PostCSS + autoprefixer and Rollup bundler (code splitting with React.lazy()) -> content hashing for cache busting -> output to podm-frontend/dist/ -> deployed to Netlify (production with SPA redirect rules, security headers via netlify.toml) or Cloudflare Pages (preview branches). Build environment includes VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_API_URL, VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. Critical warnings: JWT_SECRET exposed in frontend .env (server secret exposed to client bundle), no E2E tests run before deployment.
